sloka: विमानात् पुष्पकादद्य रावणः पतितो भुवि ।कृष्यमाणः स्त्रिया दृष्टो मुण्डः कृष्णाम्बरः पुनः ।। ५.२७.२३।।।।
transliteration: vimānāt puṣpakādadya rāvaṇaḥ patito bhuvi ।kṛṣyamāṇaḥ striyā dṛṣṭo muṇḍaḥ kṛṣṇāmbaraḥ punaḥ ।। 5.27.23।।।।

translations.english: "Tonight I saw (in another dream) Ravana with shaven head, clad in black clothes, fallen down on the ground from the Pushpaka chariot, being dragged by a woman.
